	modifier = {
		unit_provinces_lost_mult = -0.240
		battle_casualties_mult = -0.240
		unit_army_defense_mult = 0.240
	}
	possible = {
		aor1776_land_fortification_battle_eligible = yes
		aor1776_land_fort_net_protection = 24
	}
	instant_switch = {
		aor1776_land_fortification_battle_eligible = yes
		aor1776_land_fort_net_protection = 24
		NOT = {
			has_battle_condition = battle_condition_aor1776_land_fort_defense_reduced_24
		}
		NOT = {
			aor1776_land_battle_is_urgent = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			aor1776_land_battle_native_can_pursuit = yes
			aor1776_land_battle_native_can_panicked_retreat = yes
			aor1776_land_battle_native_can_controlled_retreat = yes
		}
	}
	weight = 1
}

battle_condition_aor1776_land_fort_pursuit_reduced_24 = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/battle_conditions/battle_condition_pursuit.dds"
	modifier = {
		unit_morale_loss_mult = -1
		battle_combat_width_mult = 10
		unit_provinces_lost_mult = -0.240
		battle_casualties_mult = -0.240

		OR = {
			aor1776_land_battle_native_can_pursuit = yes
			aor1776_land_battle_is_pursuit = yes
		}
	}
	weight = 1
}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/battle_conditions/battle_condition_controlled_retreat.dds"
	modifier = {
		unit_morale_loss_mult = 2
		unit_morale_damage_mult = -0.75
		unit_recovery_rate_add = 0.25
		unit_provinces_lost_mult = -0.240
		battle_casualties_mult = -0.240

	modifier = {
		unit_morale_loss_mult = 2
		unit_morale_damage_mult = -0.75
		unit_recovery_rate_add = 0.25
		unit_provinces_lost_mult = -0.290
		battle_casualties_mult = -0.290
		unit_army_defense_mult = 0.290
	}
	instant_switch = {
		aor1776_land_fortification_battle_eligible = yes
		aor1776_land_fort_net_protection = 29
		NOT = {
			has_battle_condition = battle_condition_aor1776_land_fort_controlled_retreat_reduced_29
		}
		OR = {
			aor1776_land_battle_native_can_controlled_retreat = yes
			aor1776_land_battle_is_controlled_retreat = yes
		}
	}
	weight = {
		add = 1
		scope:character ?= {
			add = experience_level
			divide = 3
		}
	}
}

	modifier = {
		unit_offense_mult = -0.5
		unit_defense_mult = -0.5
		unit_morale_damage_mult = -10
		unit_morale_loss_mult = 0.5
		unit_recovery_rate_add = -0.5
		unit_provinces_lost_mult = -0.35
		battle_casualties_mult = -0.35
		unit_army_defense_mult = 0.35
	}
	instant_switch = {
		aor1776_land_fortification_battle_eligible = yes
		aor1776_land_fort_net_protection = 35
		NOT = {
			has_battle_condition = battle_condition_aor1776_land_fort_panicked_retreat_07
		}
		OR = {
			aor1776_land_battle_native_can_panicked_retreat = yes
			aor1776_land_battle_is_panicked_retreat = yes
		}
	}
	weight = 1
}

battle_condition_aor1776_land_fort_controlled_retreat_07 = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/battle_conditions/battle_condition_controlled_retreat.dds"
	modifier = {

		aor1776_land_fortification_battle_eligible = yes
		aor1776_land_fort_net_protection = 75
		NOT = {
			has_battle_condition = battle_condition_aor1776_land_fort_controlled_retreat_15
		}
		OR = {
			aor1776_land_battle_native_can_controlled_retreat = yes
			aor1776_land_battle_is_controlled_retreat = yes
		}
	}
	weight = {
		add = 1
		scope:character ?= {
			add = experience_level
			divide = 3
		}
	}
}
